description: Multi-language .NET notebook CLI. One tool, three modes: `clrkernel jupyter` (Jupyter kernel), `clrkernel serve` (stdio JSON-RPC server for the VS Code extension), and `clrkernel run` (headless .nb.md/.dib/.ipynb runner with papermill-style parameters). C# cells evaluated with Roslyn scripting. Fork of SciSharp/ICSharpCore.
